title: Crash when reimporting (using custom script?) when imported scene is open.
body:
### Tested versions

4.7

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc (227757764) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

If you import a BSP file using my BSP importer, open the BSP file, then reimport it again, while the BSP file is open, the editor will crash.


Not sure if this will happen with built-in imported types.  I'll have to test that later.

### Steps to reproduce

Get the BSP importer add-on.
Import a BSP file.
Have a scene open.
Open the BSP file.
Press reimport on the BSP file.
Godot will try to unload and reload the BSP file and crash.
